definitions.explanation: Showing good manners and respect in speech or behavior.
Done with care and attention to detail.

examples.japanese: {丁寧|ていねい}に⟦{話|はな}して→話す：00467_hanasu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
{丁寧|ていねい}な⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}います→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
⟦{店員|てんいん}→店員：00897_tenin⟧さん⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧{丁寧|ていねい}⟦でした→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: The store clerk was very polite.

examples.japanese: {丁寧|ていねい}な⟦{手紙|てがみ}→手紙：00675_tegami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}いて→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦{送|おく}りました→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
examples.english: I wrote a polite letter and sent it.

examples.english: When I meet my teacher, I always try to greet them politely.

examples.english: She cleaned the room carefully, and everywhere became clean.

notes:
{丁寧|ていねい} is a na-adjective with two main meanings: "polite" (in manner) and "careful/thorough" (in work).

FORMS:
- Na-adjective: {丁寧|ていねい}な + noun
- Adverbial: {丁寧|ていねい}に + verb

SENSE 1 - POLITE:
- {丁寧|ていねい}な{言葉|ことば}: polite language
- {丁寧|ていねい}に{話|はな}す: to speak politely
- {丁寧語|ていねいご}: polite speech (grammar term for です/ます forms)

SENSE 2 - CAREFUL:
- {丁寧|ていねい}な{仕事|しごと}: careful work
- {丁寧|ていねい}に{作|つく}る: to make carefully
- {丁寧|ていねい}に{説明|せつめい}する: to explain thoroughly

CONTRAST:
- {乱暴|らんぼう}: rough, violent (opposite for careful)
- {失礼|しつれい}: rude, impolite (opposite for polite)
